caseNameFull: Texaco Inc. v. Hasbrouck, dba Rick's Texaco

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of National Association of Texaco Wholesalers, Society of Independent Gasoline Marketers of America et al., Petroleum Marketers Association of America, and National Association of Manufacturers of the United States et al. for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this case expressing the views of the United States.
